Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is primarily a cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) study using BS3 and DSBU. While the study focuses on N-glycans and uses PNGase F for deglycosylation prior to MS analysis to simplify the peptide landscape, the MS analysis itself is performed on the resulting peptides. The 'mod_glyco' hint is included because the biological target is the glycoproteome and site-specific glycoproteomics were mentioned.
